Lantern · API service docs
Lantern docs sentinel

One API for the whole storefront.

Lantern is the Lighthouse backend service. It powers products, carts, checkout, and accounts for the Harbor web app behind a single typed HTTP interface — with structured errors your team can trace to a request.

EndpointsTyped routes for products, carts, checkout, and orders, each documented with example requests.
AuthSigned session tokens issued by the shared auth service and verified on every request.
ObservabilityEvery unhandled error is fingerprinted and grouped so a spike points straight at its route.
